description: Headless GIMP: expand, contract, border, feather, smooth, invert or harden a saved selection. Refused if the target channel already confines a filter.

image.description: Image id, as returned by gimp_open_document.

op.description: expand/contract/border/feather require `px` (> 0). harden: threshold a soft mask at 50%. smooth: round off jagged edges (`px` optional, floors at 1px).

output.description: Write to this saved selection instead of modifying `channel` in place.

px.description: Radius in document pixels, rounded to the nearest whole pixel. Required (> 0) for expand/contract/border/feather; optional for smooth; unused otherwise. expand/contract/border cap at 150 on an ordinary document, LOWER on a very large one (morphological ops whose cost scales with both the radius and the document's own megapixels — the error names the actual cap for that document when a value is refused); feather has no such cap up to 1000 (a GEGL blur, flat cost regardless of radius).

name: gimp_modify_selection
